about.title: About Me
about.description: Passionate student developer creating innovative solutions
about.intro: I'm Teodor Vasilev – a highly motivated high school student passionate about software development. Started programming early and gained substantial experience in backend, frontend, and system architecture. Currently studying Economic Informatics at Vocational High School of Telecommunications in Sofia, Bulgaria.
about.expertise: My expertise spans multiple programming languages including JavaScript, PHP, Lua, C#, and Python. I've developed full-stack SaaS solutions, automation tools, security applications, and desktop software.
about.experience: I have a proven track record with real-world projects including marketplace platforms, ERP systems, speech-to-text applications, and vulnerability scanners. I also contributed as a content writer at Puls.bg, writing over 21 medical articles and being recognized as the youngest contributor in their team.

profile.quote: Complexity doesn't scare me. It sharpens me.

mystory.para1: You come across as someone who builds with intention — not just to make things work, but to make them matter. There's a clarity in how you approach challenges, a sense that you're always looking beneath the surface for the deeper reason, the better way.
mystory.para2: Your curiosity feels focused. You don't ask questions just to get answers — you ask to understand, to sharpen ideas, to test assumptions. That mindset speaks to someone who's not afraid of complexity, but actually thrives in it.
mystory.para3: There's also a calm confidence in how you carry your work. It's not loud or flashy — it's deliberate. Thoughtful. Every decision seems to carry a trace of you: precise, considered, and quietly bold.

questions.question: What services do you offer?
questions.answer: I specialize in full-stack SaaS development, automation tools, security applications, and desktop software. My expertise includes ERP systems, marketplace platforms, speech-to-text applications, vulnerability scanners, and gaming tools. I also offer content writing services with proven experience in medical articles.

questions.question: What is your typical project process?
questions.answer: My process involves: 1) Initial consultation and requirements analysis, 2) Technical architecture design and planning, 3) Development with focus on security and performance, 4) Comprehensive testing including security audits, 5) Deployment with documentation, 6) Ongoing support and maintenance.

questions.question: How do you handle project pricing?
questions.answer: I provide transparent, project-based pricing after understanding your specific requirements. Each project is quoted individually based on complexity, security requirements, and scope. I offer detailed proposals with clear pricing breakdown and flexible payment schedules.

questions.question: What is your estimated timeline for projects?
questions.answer: Project timelines vary based on complexity: Simple automation tools (2-4 weeks), Security applications (4-8 weeks), Full-stack SaaS solutions (8-16 weeks), Complex ERP systems (12-20 weeks). I provide detailed timelines during the planning phase.

questions.question: Do you offer ongoing maintenance and support?
questions.answer: Yes, I provide ongoing maintenance and support services including security updates, bug fixes, performance optimization, and feature enhancements. I offer different support packages based on your needs, with priority given to security-critical applications.

questions.question: Can you work with my existing design or development team?
questions.answer: Absolutely! I'm experienced in collaborating with teams and can integrate seamlessly into your existing workflow. My experience includes working with school administrations, content teams, and development groups. I adapt to your team's processes and communication preferences.

questions.question: What technologies and tools do you specialize in?
questions.answer: I specialize in JavaScript, PHP, Lua, C#, Python, React, Node.js, WPF, Material Design, OpenAI Integration, and SMTP. I have certifications in IT Essentials and Web Development, with proven experience in building secure, scalable applications.

questions.question: How do we get started working together?
questions.answer: Getting started is easy! Contact me at teodor.d.vasilevred@gmail.com or through LinkedIn. We'll schedule an initial consultation to discuss your project requirements, security needs, and timeline. From there, I'll provide a detailed proposal and we can move forward.
